name: Confirm the hiring partner and rule how the pre-opening hiring burst is run
text_content:
Type: founder decision

The record assigns no partner to the hiring workstream. Session 4 marked it founder-gated with a recommendation of Brandon's seat (S4 P4, S4 work item W5), and Session 5 depends on it everywhere: pre-opening, the hiring partner opens every seat, runs every pipeline in the leads' place, and decides every packet (P14, P28, section 12.1). Session 5 adds the second half of the decision, P49: how the burst itself is run. The team recommends the hiring partner runs the process with the stack until the two leads are seated, the leads are hired first and then hire their own domains, and no contracted recruiting help is engaged. Whether to contract help for the burst is the partners' to decide and is a cost question this program does not price. If help is engaged, it is engaged against the mutual-commitments document and never against her recruiter's interview loop (I29). Second in the order because this seat runs the burst, opens the first seats, and decides the first packets.

Filed by Session 5 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhm4. Reasoning lives on the S5 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
